title: 阿萝拉·灵兔茶盘
description: 戴圆眼镜的红发兔耳阿萝拉端着小茶盘，身旁两只柔和小灵体陪伴。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Aurora is an adult rabbit vastaya with long upright rabbit ears, red-orange hair, round spectacles, soft freckles, and a large fluffy rabbit tail. Preserve her scholarly witchlike silhouette with a broad hat placed beside her, a warm fully covering green-brown travel outfit, opaque tights, and boots. Her small magical wand or staff stays inactive near her satchel, accompanied by gentle round spirit shapes.
art_direction.scene: She kneels beside a low woodland table and carries a tiny tea tray toward two curious harmless spirits. One spirit peeks around a cup while another floats near her ear, leaving her face unobstructed. A rounded tree stump and one mushroom suggest the clearing, with ample warm paper and a gentle investigative smile.
art_direction.palette: moss green, ginger orange, warm cream, mist blue
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
